description: Sets the current site used by all site-scoped tools (pushengage_send_notification, pushengage_list_segments, pushengage_get_analytics_summary, pushengage_list_drip_campaigns, etc.) when no site_id is provided. Persists across MCP restarts. Call pushengage_list_sites first to get a valid site_id.
name: pushengage_select_site
title: Select current site
